name: Will You Fall?
source:
Someone lovingly waking you up every morning wasn’t the life you were used to. But things are better now. So, you decide to come to terms with your past. But at what cost?

[From [url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian app[/url]]
translation:
每天清晨被人温柔唤醒，并不是你原本习惯的生活。但如今一切都好起来了，于是你决定直面并释怀自己的过去。只是，这需要付出怎样的代价？

[摘自[url=https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.dorian.playtogether]Dorian应用[/url]]
